labels.low: Pay in the normal cycle. Every hard control passes (vendor, bank, PO, goods receipt, duplicates) and nothing is out of pattern. A credit memo that references a real prior invoice is low.
labels.medium: A clerk should look before payment. Hard controls pass, but there is one soft signal (urgency language, first invoice from a new vendor, small price variance, stale invoice, approval still missing).
labels.high: A manager must review before payment. A hard control fails or the pattern looks engineered (no PO where one is required, goods receipt missing, price variance above 15 percent, amount hugging the approval threshold, large amount far outside the vendor's range).
labels.hold: Block payment and verify out of band. There is a concrete identity or duplicate red flag (remit-to bank changed without verified call-back, same invoice number with a different amount, look-alike vendor that is not in the master, exact duplicate, vendor blocked).

production_mix_assumption.note: ASSUMPTION, not a measurement. Replace with the stratum mix of your own invoice stream before using any 100k projection.
